evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: an unrehearsed rollback is opposed to a rollback one actually has — matched clause structure crystallizing a rule.
Recurring organizational formula naming a cadence-and-activity compound; the phrasing is signature enough to repeat across documents.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the rule here crystallized into matched opposed clauses that make the contrast itself the argument?
